fixture_import.note: Host tests call inspect_kernel on the live fixture. They do not vendor a kernel image. Root tool and fixtures were not edited here.

changes: Removed the SEPFW/TrustCache/preoslog address-and-size multiple-of-8 gate. Pinned memcpy8 is a byte copy.
Kept RAM bounds, heap overlap rejection, 16K heap alignment, and 16K guest displacement.
Kept the 16K preoslog rule so predicted BootArgs stay 16K-aligned. That is a launcher selection. Stock load_raw adds the raw preoslog size and does not require it.
Added a host test that odd SEPFW and TrustCache address/size values are accepted and page-rounded in the predicted layout.
Added one main-thread SIGALRM/ITIMER_REAL capture request ten seconds after the complete exact HV_START command enters its outer reply. No timer thread, self-PID signal or extra reader.

Injection requires the written outer frame, reply depth one, zero command/bulk I/O/boot and event dispatch depths, no active HV handler, and no prior injection or close. Unsafe boundaries stop without a new interrupt byte.
Full serial write counts are checked. Partial start frames never arm the alarm; failed interrupt writes cannot qualify as an injected capture.
Ordinary pre-capture HOOK_VM service retains pinned HANDLED acknowledgement. Every supported unexpected context is saved diagnostically before dispatch. No command is permitted after bounded capture.
Saved original ExcInfo bytes and parsed ELR, SPSR, x0, x19 and CPU ID privately. Missing, unreadable or malformed contexts remain errors and cannot reuse earlier callback data.

Compared inspected relocated park PC, x0 BootArgs pointer, x19=3, sole running CPU and SPSR DAIF/mode masked by 0x3df against 0x3c5. Only an actual one-shot injection followed by HV/USER_INTERRUPT can match; full console line and evidence still require independent review.

Documented the receive-parser-to-dispatch race and possible autonomous pinned target reboot after transport read failure. The launcher issues no resume after capture and no target reboot command; target state after disconnect is unknown.
limits: Forty host-only tests use nonbootable packets, fake transport/HV/context/process objects and a mocked signal scheduler. They neither schedule actual alarms nor open serial devices or import pinned m1n1.
No build, SSH, hardware execution, real parked context or guest runtime evidence was obtained by this work. The default offline CLI plan was separately exercised without device contact.

Normal pre-capture HOOK_VM acknowledgements are allowed; after capture there is no continuation, retry or cleanup command. Closing or killing the host worker can cause an autonomous target reboot through the pinned transport-failure path; not every close is proven to do so.
An interrupt can race a callback frame already parsed but not yet dispatched. That may lose the sole shot; unexpected contexts remain diagnostic and no automatic boot verdict is produced.
A passing test, expected_park_conditions_match boolean, marker string or worker outcome is not a hardware boot, full kernel initialization or reviewed checkpoint proof.
Earlier independent review reports predate this capture revision and do not attest these frozen hashes.

capture_contract.alarm: main-thread SIGALRM; ITIMER_REAL 10 seconds; one shot; disarm finally
capture_contract.eligible_event: START.HV / USER_INTERRUPT following this worker completed injection
